robust.selection: baseline and candidate observations are both at least 100 ns/iter

metric_contract.direction: positive means the candidate is faster
metric_contract.paired_range: min and max of same-repetition A/B speedup percentages

evidence.benchmark_reuse_basis: The timed normal paths execute identical instructions against identical primary data sections, so the completed A/B campaigns remain applicable to the final rebased source.
evidence.metadata_boundary: The final rebase refactors an inlined semantic helper and adjusts tests. It preserves .text, .rodata, .data, section sizes, and BSS sizes. Whole-ELF build IDs and source-location records change; .data.rel.ro differences are confined to 54 baseline bytes and 4 candidate bytes in source-location entries.
evidence.verdict: Normal-path executable code and primary immutable/mutable data sections are byte-identical to the measured binaries after the final rebase.

provenance.selection_rule: confirmatory n5 supersedes targeted n5, which supersedes stratified n4, for overlapping repeated leaves; samples from different campaigns are never pooled
